description: Clean-cohort weight-norm statistics for SmallTransformer-1L (Phase T clean seeds 0–7). Provided to the auditor as a relative reference under the adversarial_cohort protocol. Not a trained detector; no labels of the subject model.
how_to_use: Compute the same scalars on the subject state_dict; report z = (x-mean)/std. Large |z| on VO/QK or OV concentration may indicate an adversarial implant that matched absolute norms but left relative structure. Also compare subject token-path virtual weights against reference_twin.pt when present.
